exposures = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness']).copy()
regions = pd.get_dummies(d['region'], drop_first=True).astype(float).values
print("NUMPY_MARKER_ZZZ")
for e in exposures:
    dd = d.dropna(subset=[e]).copy()
    r = pd.get_dummies(dd['region'], drop_first=True).astype(float).values
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(dd)), dd[e].values, r])
    y = dd['species_richness'].values
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    resid = y - X@beta
    n,k = X.shape
    s2 = resid@resid/(n-k)
    cov = s2*np.linalg.inv(X.T@X)
    se = np.sqrt(cov[1,1])
    t = beta[1]/se
    from scipy import stats
    p = 2*stats.t.sf(abs(t), n-k)
    print("NUMPY", e, round(beta[1],4), round(se,4), round(t,3), round(p,4))

from scipy import stats
rng = np.random.default_rng(20240607)

d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness']).copy()
D = pd.get_dummies(d['region'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
base = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(d)), D.values])
y = d['species_richness'].values
def fit(X):
    b,*_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None); r=y-X@b; n,k=X.shape
    return b, r@r, n, k
b0,rss0,n,k0 = fit(base)

    y = dd['species_richness'].values
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    resid = y - X@beta
    n,k = X.shape
